newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Hui Shung buys 54,000 tonnes U.S. soy/corn.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Hui Shung buys 54,000 tonnes U.S. soy/corn.

text.p: Taiwan's Hui Shung Group bought a combined shipment of 38,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans and 16,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn from Kanematsu at a tender on Tuesday, Taipei traders said.

The successful bid was the second in a week by Kanematsu, a newcomer to Taiwan's grain market. The Japanese trading house made a splashy debut on October 3 with a major tender sale to Hui Shung Group.
Kanematsu has come into the market with what traders called particularly low prices. Its price for the first shipment saved Hui Shung about US$10,000 over the next best bid, traders said.
The Hui Shung Group includes Hui Shung Agriculture and Food Corp, Eagle Food Industry and Charoen Pokphand.
Freight for the shipment was fixed at US$18.70 per tonne on an FOB basis, traders said.
